text:
Salutations care team,
At dusk changed little, but welfare walks stayed in focus

Please move urgent companion animal cases to the front of review and keep each file tight, clear, and current for the desk ledger. The senior coordinator needs immediate visibility on any carrier swap, kennel delay, or cabin exception so we can protect the passenger experience and the animal's welfare. If a traveler arrives with incomplete papers or a stressed pet, route the case at once through the Companion Animal Travel Desk and note every handling change before the next handoff.

The ground team must continue careful carrier movement between services and confirm every label before release. <<FACT F078>> Keep the tone calm with travelers, but do not soften the urgency in your notes, because fast action and accurate records are both required for Aurelia Skyways. If a case begins to drift from plan, escalate without waiting, and keep the senior coordinator informed until the file is closed cleanly.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
